title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
key_facts: Meta announced Muse Spark Open and calls it the most capable US open-weight model to date
Meta says it is the first model in its class that can run on a desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with Apple's MLX framework
Model is natively multimodal with 816 billion total parameters, per Meta
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg thanked Apple CEO John Ternus on X; Ternus replied praising the on-device result
Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, told Axios the companies had collaborated for several months
Apple published a technical post on MLX, Muse Spark Open and two other open models
quote_evidence: Meta and Apple, typically rivals, worked together on the launch and are publicly supporting each other.
"Muse Spark Open -- weights releasing today -- runs great on new Mac Studios thanks to work with @johnternus and Apple," Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said on X.
The new model is a "natively multimodal model" with 816 billion total parameters.
why_it_matters_hint: Two usually rival tech giants jointly back running a large open model on a desk computer.
notes: Performance and "most capable" claims are Meta's own. Same model is covered as a model story in category 1 (C01-01); this entry is the Meta and Apple partnership angle.
